user.title: Feedparser
user.description: Create a sensor from an RSS/Atom feed. Refresh and parsing options can be changed later.

data_description.name: Friendly name for the sensor.
data_description.feed_url: RSS or Atom feed URL. HTTP, HTTPS, and local file URLs are supported.
data_description.date_format: Python strftime format used for feed dates, for example `%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S %Z`.
data_description.local_time: Convert feed timestamps to Home Assistant's configured local time before formatting.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to refresh the feed. The minimum interval is 1 minute.
data_description.show_topn: Maximum number of entries exposed in the `entries` attribute. Large values increase state size.
data_description.remove_summary_image: Strip image tags from the `summary` field. This does not remove a separate `image` field.
data_description.match: Optional regular expression. Only entries whose title or summary contains a match are kept, ignoring case, for example `Leicester` or `rain|snow`. Leave empty to keep all entries.
data_description.exclude_match: Optional regular expression. Entries whose title or summary contains a match are removed, ignoring case. Applied together with the filter above.
data_description.inclusions: Optional comma-separated allowlist, for example `title, link, published`. Leave empty to keep all fields except exclusions.
data_description.exclusions: Optional comma-separated fields to remove. Exclusions are applied after inclusions.
data_description.user_agent: Optional HTTP User-Agent sent when fetching the feed. Some servers block or stall unknown clients; set a browser User-Agent for those. Leave empty to use the default.

reconfigure.title: Change feed
reconfigure.description: Change the sensor name or the feed URL. The entity ID and history are kept.

data_description.feed_url: RSS or Atom feed URL. HTTP, HTTPS, and local file URLs are supported.

error.already_configured: A sensor with this name already exists for this feed. Choose a different name.
error.invalid_feed: The URL was downloaded but does not look like an RSS or Atom feed.
error.scan_interval_too_short: Refresh interval must be at least 1 minute.

abort.managed_in_ui: This feed is managed in the UI.
abort.managed_in_yaml: "{name}" is set up in configuration.yaml. Change its name or URL there and restart Home Assistant, or first move it to the UI from its options.

yaml.title: Managed in configuration.yaml
yaml.description:
"{name}" is set up in configuration.yaml. To change it, edit configuration.yaml and restart Home Assistant.

You can also manage this feed in the UI instead.

menu_options.move_to_ui: Manage this feed in the UI instead

move_to_ui.title: Manage in the UI
move_to_ui.description:
From now on, "{name}" is edited here and its entry in configuration.yaml is ignored. The sensor and its entity ID stay the same.

After submitting, remove "{name}" from configuration.yaml.

error.scan_interval_too_short: Refresh interval must be at least 1 minute.

yaml_import_failed.title: Feedparser YAML sensor "{name}" could not be set up
yaml_import_failed.description:
The YAML sensor "{name}" could not be set up ({reason}), so it is not being created.

Check its entry in configuration.yaml, or add it under Settings > Devices & services > Add integration > Feedparser instead.

yaml_ignored.title: Feedparser sensor "{name}" is still in configuration.yaml
yaml_ignored.description:
"{name}" is managed in the UI, so its `platform: feedparser` entry in configuration.yaml is ignored.

Remove it from configuration.yaml and restart Home Assistant to fix this issue.
